name: Sahel insurgency
value: JNIM IED near Sévaré 2 Nov; no city falls
summary: JNIM claims an IED attack on Malian and Russian troops near Sévaré on 2 Nov; insurgency steady; no major city has fallen
state: JNIM claimed an IED attack on a vehicle carrying Malian army and Russian Africa Corps personnel on the Sévaré–Konna road in Mopti region on 2 Nov; casualties are unverified (Counter-IED Report). UNHCR said on 10 Nov that about 64,000 people have fled violence in northern Nigeria to Niger in 2026, with Diffa accounting for over 70% of Niger's security incidents (UN News). No fall of a capital or major city and no mass-casualty spread to coastal states was found as of 11 Nov, though reporting is thin.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to Mali, Burkina Faso and most of Niger. Insurgent attacks disrupt roads, fuel supplies and aid; people with links to the region should check FCDO advice before any travel.
rubric_hit: Watch: sustained insurgency; no capital or major city blockaded or fallen (Alert line)

sources.title: Counter-IED Report — Mali: JNIM claims IED attack on Malian Army and Africa Corps vehicle in Mopti region

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
